recommendation: Allocate the 25 units proportionally and fairly across the three teams while preserving a small contingency buffer for the 14-day gap to the next delivery. A balanced split is: Support 10, Engineering 8, Sales 7. This uses all 25 units and keeps the distribution aligned with demand intensity (Support highest, then Engineering, then Sales) without fully satisfying any single request. Contingency plan: if unexpected urgent needs arise before the next delivery, reallocate any returned/unused units first to Support and Engineering, since they have the largest unmet requests, and keep a short reserve only if operationally necessary. If no return/reallocation occurs, revisit priorities at the next delivery in 14 days.
quality_notes: Fair allocation based on relative demand rather than first-come-first-served.
No request is fully met, so the plan avoids overfavoring one team.
Recommendation explicitly accounts for the 14-day replenishment window and includes a contingency approach.
